text:
people-ops: Dropping a tiny 'Goal Bitecards' pack 7 for quick calibration/1:1 use. Each bitecard = 1-line outcome, 1 concise evidence fragment, 1 immediate ask / owner. Aimed for rapid scan in calibration rooms and to paste into manager notes. PTAL @rachel @kevin.

people-ops: Examples (copyable):

people-ops: ```
[Eng] Outcome: Reduced P95 gen latency 15%.
Evidence: Kernel change + KV cache; P95 420ms -> 357ms.
Ask: Request 0.2 FTE infra for canary + rollback plan. | owner: kevin | conf: med
```

rachel: Love this. Suggest adding a mini-tag for benefits/hiring ops if the ask involves headcount or parental/benefits changes. e.g., `ops: hiring/human-resources`.

kevin: Also add a one-line Slack paste variant: `Eng: -15% P95  KV+kernel  Need 0.2FTE infra (kevin)` so skip-levels can copy quickly.

amir: For managers: include a "manager wiring" note if action requires payroll/benefit change (e.g., phased return, equipment). Tiny example: `Manager: Add onboarding laptop + confirm phased pay with HR@people-ops`.

people-ops: Good calls. We'll: 1) add `ops:` tag option, 2) include Slack-paste single-line variant, 3) add one manager-wiring example that references #hiring-ops and HR contact.

people-ops-bot: Heads-up: we'll publish the Bitecards page 2024-08-01. Announcement to #announcements on publish day.

rachel: I'll pilot these with two managers next week and share three real bitecards back.

people-ops: Thanks! We'll update the doc with the ops tags and paste variants and ping for quick thumbs. :white_check_mark:
